headline: Jio Platforms IPO fully subscribed in under two hours
summary: Jio Platforms launched its massive public offering, drawing heavy demand and becoming fully subscribed within hours led by institutional investors.
why: Jio Platforms is a major digital services and telecommunications subsidiary in India. Strong initial public offering demand reflects investor appetite for large-scale emerging market technology and telecom assets.

impacts.name: Jio Platforms
impacts.why: Heavy institutional demand during initial public offerings reflects strong investor appetite for digital assets.

why_moved: Jio Platforms drew heavy initial public offering demand and became fully subscribed within hours, reflecting strong institutional investor appetite.
